title: Shark Messmaster Wet/Dry Vacuum $60 + $9.95 Delivery ($0 with $99 Order) @ MYER / $50 Price Check + Delivery @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: Shark Messmaster Wet/Dry Vacuum $60 + $9.95 Delivery ($0 with $99 Order) @ MYER / $50 Price Check + Delivery @ The Good Guys

[Crispcabbage] Nice! Definitely not as good as the $29 offer last year but still better than the next cheapest of $69
[probablynotlauren] Back in my day I could pick these up for $29…
[tightm8] Back in my day, redskins would cost 10c…
[jcon] Pffft. You 10c Redskin whippersnappers.
Back in my day they were 5c, and an Icy Pole was 20c.
[Dollar Dreamer] @jcon: Pfft, all you kiddies, in my day you could buy a wife for $2.50.
[cycloneaussie] @Dollar Dreamer: Suckered in at the low buy, sunk with maintenance costs
[garygaz] Back in my day, they were still called redskins
[Lizard Spock] @garygaz: Now we call them Native American Indians.
[y2k] I got one of these, returned it as I didn't think I would use it enough, and then when it dropped to $69 I could not resist. It has a very particular use case - when I want to pick up wet solids like wet dirt on my balcony after gardening, or maybe some chunky and saucy food spills. Pretty rare. Curious to know what other uses people have for this that isn't covered by say, a stick Dyson V11 or a Bissell carpet cleaner.
[cnut] Took out debris from the idiot tilers and tradies that let it fall into the shower pipes.
Great for the car too.
[Fergy1987] Omfg I had the same issue flooded my (profanity) shower. Found a pen and a bunch of shit down there. Morons
[EyyBanane] a bunch of shit down there
You mean, they did their business in the shower?
[Manny Calavera] @EyyBanane: You never waffle stomped before?
[Slave1] Thank you for this! I have one and didn’t even think to use it to vacuum out the bathroom drain that’s filled with hair, powder and years of fluff!
[CrypticM] You mean shower drain or drain located outside shower? Can we use this here? I didn't think about it…good use case.
[EyyBanane] I wouldn't do that. I use a cheap $5 sewer dredging tool (from Aliexpress) connected to a drill, and it works wonders. If I use a vacuum for it, I will have to throw it away!
[ozeebee] I love mine. It's a great car vacuum as long as you have power socket access nearby. Compared to stick vacuums that doesn't have enough power to clean anything.
[spock] WOW 780 kilowatt that is 1046 horse power your better off buying this than a Ev.lol
[Providence] lol. Copy pasted from Myer website. Should be 780W I think.
[Jamie777] Mm… over priced… (looking at my one unopened with 29 dollar price tag)
[JumpingUnicorns] I'm using my $29 one and far out I love it. I almost want to buy another at this price as a spare
[cyrax83] Great for the car just wish it had a longer hose
[OBH] Dp you find it has enough suction to pull sand/dirt from the car?
[ijkijk01] Wanted to buy this as a spot cleaner, except it doesn't come with scrub and spray attachments
[simo1919] So this one is just a vacuum cleaner that suctions liquid/dry but no spray and suction to do spot cleaning?!
[Inthemix] Great vacuum for the car, just needs a longer hose (only gripe)
[Rincewind] How this compare
https://www.bunnings.com.au/ozito-1250w-12l-stainless-wet-an…
I am finding the ozito functional but bulky for my use.. Is the shark more convenient?
[Checkmate3023] Got this for like 30-40 bucks on a deal and it is actually really good
[butwhy] How does this go sucking water out of carpet?
I had a Bissell Spot cleaner and it was truly hopeless - noisy and useless water suction (despite sending it back for warranty repair)
[Davo1111] you can get an ozito for 50% more wattage and $10 less. I would assume that would result in more suction?
[jikijiki] I spilt a bit of chocolate coconut water on my carpet (maybe 10% of a cup) and although liquid was sucked into the receptacle, the carpet was still slightly stained. Id say it did 90% of the job after using all the provided attachments and holding the suction on the affected area
[belongsinforums] There are videos where people test this on YouTube
[AngryAlfred] From a dog owner, it's really good. My old spot cleaner broke so I recently bought a brush head for this to use as a replacement, just need to spray solution from a bottle
[littlesoldier] Bought it last christmas, still in the box LOL
[fatduckling] Bought two for $39 each. Both still in the box lol
[montorola] Bought it last christmas
Last Christmas, you bought a vacuum
But the very next day, you got lazy
This year, to save yourself from tears
You'll actually open and use ittttt 🎵
[BlueDiesel] The Typical question with these kind of gadgets: Buy one and be guaranteed to never need it, or pass and definitely need it as soon as the sale is over….?
[scirocco] won't pull the trigger if it is more than $29.
[Averell] dumb question - what's the difference in usage between this one and a corded Dyson?
[werdplaya58] If buying through Myer, do it through the Myer One app and check if you have any unused $10 rewards accumulated.
I used one + discounted Myer gift card to buy for $48
[joebalds] couldn't suck the skin of a custard, also deceptivley marketed as 'portable' despite being corded - but you won't see it in any images.
[dts88] Perfect timing with my unused TGG credit
[Mikael] Tgg says stock but payment won't go through. Think party over for tgg. $1 taken and reverted. Oh well. By reading, guess a good thing.
[pinkscarf] Thanks purchased for $50 on tgg for click &’collect!
